- Create a project charter / elevator pitch and goals
- Write a Product Requirements Document (PRD) / scope / MVP
- Produce a technical spec / architecture diagram
- Generate a roadmap / milestones and timeline

- Draft a README, license, contributing guidelines
- Estimate effort / team & roles / risks

Here’s a practical, prioritized deployment action-items checklist you can use as a playbook. It’s organized by phase (Preparation → CI/CD → Release → Post-release) with key actions, owners/suggested roles, and short acceptance criteria. Tell me your stack (cloud, containers vs VMs, orchestrator, DB) and I’ll tailor it and produce a runnable checklist or CI/CD config.

Preparation (pre-release)
- Confirm release scope & artifacts
  - Action: Freeze features; list commits/PRs to include.
  - Owner: PM / Release Lead
  - Acceptance: Changelog and release notes created; commit SHAs recorded.
- Build reproducible artifacts
  - Action: Create versioned builds (Docker image tags, build artifacts).
  - Owner: Dev
  - Acceptance: Signed/hashed artifacts in artifact registry.
- Update changelog & release notes
  - Action: Draft human-readable notes, migration steps, known issues.
  - Owner: PM / Dev
  - Acceptance: Release notes approved.
- Ensure infra-as-code is current
  - Action: Update Terraform/CloudFormation/ARM/Helm charts for required infra changes.
  - Owner: Platform/DevOps
  - Acceptance: IaC code reviewed & tests passing in PR.
- Verify environment parity & config
  - Action: Confirm env-specific configs (secrets, feature flags, endpoints).
  - Owner: DevOps / SRE
  - Acceptance: All environment variables & secrets documented and accessible by pipeline.
- Data migration plan
  - Action: List DB schema changes, write migration scripts, plan downtime or online migrations.
  - Owner: DB Lead / Dev
  - Acceptance: Migration scripts tested on staging; rollback migration prepared.

CI/CD pipeline & automation
- Build & run tests in pipeline
  - Action: Configure pipeline to run unit, integration, lint, security scans.
  - Owner: Dev
  - Acceptance: Pipeline green for build artifact.
- Static analysis & security scanning
  - Action: Add SAST, dependency scanning (e.g., Snyk/Dependabot), container scanning.
  - Owner: Security / DevOps
  - Acceptance: Vulnerabilities triaged; critical/blocked ones resolved or documented with mitigation.
- Create blue/green or canary deployment jobs
  - Action: Implement deployment strategies (k8s rollout, feature flags, traffic shifting).
  - Owner: DevOps
  - Acceptance: Canary process configured and capable of rollback.
- Artifact promotion & immutable tagging
  - Action: Promote artifacts from build -> staging -> production with immutable tags.
  - Owner: CI/CD Owner
  - Acceptance: Promotion steps automated; provenance tracked.
- Secrets management
  - Action: Use vault/secret manager (AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault) integrated with pipeline.
  - Owner: DevOps / Security
  - Acceptance: No plain-text secrets in repos; access limited & audited.

Staging & pre-deploy validation
- Deploy to staging
  - Action: Deploy the exact prod-bindable artifact & IaC to staging.
  - Owner: DevOps
  - Acceptance: Staging deploy successful and mirrors prod config.
- Run end-to-end & smoke tests
  - Action: Automated E2E tests, performance baseline tests, migration dry-run.
  - Owner: QA / Dev
  - Acceptance: E2E & smoke tests pass; performance within expected thresholds.
- Load & performance testing (if applicable)
  - Action: Run load tests for expected traffic; validate scaling behavior.
  - Owner: SRE / Performance Eng
  - Acceptance: No critical regressions; autoscaling behaves correctly.
- Operational readiness & runbooks
  - Action: Update runbooks for deploy, rollback, troubleshooting, and escalation contacts.
  - Owner: SRE / DevOps
  - Acceptance: Runbooks reviewed and accessible.

Production release (runbook)
- Schedule release & notify stakeholders
  - Action: Communicate timing, expected impact, maintenance windows.
  - Owner: Release Lead
  - Acceptance: Stakeholders acknowledged.
- Final pre-deploy checklist
  - Action: Verify monitoring, alerting, backup status, DB backups taken, maintenance pages ready.
  - Owner: Release Lead / SRE
  - Acceptance: All checks confirmed.
- Execute deployment (recommended safe approach)
  - Action: Deploy using canary or blue/green:
    1) Deploy new version to small canary cohort
    2) Run automated smoke checks against canary
    3) If OK, incrementally shift traffic / scale to full rollout
  - Owner: DevOps / Release Engineer
  - Acceptance: Canary health checks pass; metrics stable during incremental traffic shift.
- Run post-deploy verification
  - Action: Smoke tests, critical-path user flows, DB integrity checks.
  - Owner: QA / Dev
  - Acceptance: All verification checks pass.
- Monitor closely & hold period
  - Action: Monitor logs, metrics, SLO/SLI, error budgets for N minutes/hours.
  - Owner: SRE
  - Acceptance: No new major alerts; key metrics stable.

Rollback & mitigation
- Have an explicit rollback plan
  - Action: Define rollback steps: revert traffic, redeploy previous artifact, DB rollback if necessary.
  - Owner: Release Lead / DevOps / DB Lead
  - Acceptance: Rollback steps tested on staging; rollback executed within defined RTO if required.
- Emergency stop/kill switch
  - Action: Provide commands or console switches to cut traffic (e.g., disable load balancer target, pause job).
  - Owner: SRE
  - Acceptance: Kill switch tested and accessible.

Post-release
- Post-deploy verification & sign-off
  - Action: Collect sign-offs from QA, SRE, PM.
  - Owner: Release Lead
  - Acceptance: Formal sign-off recorded.
- Postmortem / retrospective
  - Action: If anything went wrong, run blameless postmortem; capture improvements.
  - Owner: Team Lead / PM
  - Acceptance: Action items assigned with owners and due dates.
- Document lessons learned & update runbooks
  - Action: Update runbooks and playbooks based on experience.
  - Owner: SRE / Dev
  - Acceptance: Documentation updated and reviewed.
- Metrics & user feedback review
  - Action: Monitor product metrics for longer-term effects and collect user feedback.
  - Owner: PM / Analytics
  - Acceptance: No critical regressions; KPIs OK or actions planned.

Security & compliance checks (ongoing)
- Final vulnerability & secrets sweep before prod deploy
  - Action: Run last-minute vulnerability scans and ensure no secrets leaked.
  - Owner: Security
  - Acceptance: No high-severity findings.
- Audit & compliance logs enabled
  - Action: Ensure access logging, audit trails, and retention policies are enabled.
  - Owner: Security / Compliance
  - Acceptance: Logs are being collected centrally and accessible.

Helpful templates (quick)
- Short release checklist (pre-deploy)
  - Build green, tests green, migration tested, backup taken, monitoring active, stakeholders notified.
- Release day runbook (commands)
  - Scripted commands for deploy, health-check endpoints, rollback commands, and escalation tree (phone/emails).
- Post-release sign-off form
  - Checklist + signatures (PM, QA, SRE).

Notes on automation and safety
- Prefer automated promotion and canary rollouts to manual pushes.
- Keep deployments small & frequent to reduce blast radius.
- Use feature flags for risky changes to allow toggling without redeploying.
- Always test rollback paths on staging and periodically run disaster recovery drills.

If you want:
- I can turn this into a templated runbook (text file) with placeholders for commands and URLs for your environment.
- Or I can generate a one-page release checklist you can print and use at deploy time.
